items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Johnny Dodds played for the parade, you know. With who? With Tuxedo, yeah.

ctx.x: You hear Johnny Dodds much down here?
I knew you were playing with the band with Oliver. Johnny Dodds played for the parade, you know. With who? With Tuxedo, yeah. Tuxedo and the Exorcist band. Johnny Dodds was a good man.
Well, he must have been a reader.
